texts: When do sky-cats descend from the cliff-spires?

fields.sentence: When do sky-cats descend from the cliff-spires?

q2_gaps: a 'when' question whose subject is a bare-plural generic: the instruction set stores such a statement as an Implication rule over Skolem-function events ((sk_descend $x)) and supplies a query form only for an individuated member ('Query a distributed member like any event' — 'Did Ana pass?'), so no licensed pattern reaches the rule's consequent when no instance of the kind exists in the KB
review.notes: Within the licensed query vocabulary the shape is right: Source for 'from' (whence), Agent for the self-propelled intransitive subject, GroupOf binding of the definite plural 'the cliff-spires', open (Time $e $t) per Time questions' 'When?', and no tense atom for the present habitual.
